title: Coming in 2027: Apple’s $1,000 home robot for FaceTime and switching on lights
hook_text: Apple is building a home robot.
hook_before: Apple is developing a one thousand dollar home robot for 2027.
script:
One thousand dollars for a new Apple home robot.
CEO John Ternus is leading the project to bring this device into your living room.
The machine uses a robotic arm to handle FaceTime calls and manage smart home lights.
It also features a roaming base that follows you around the house.
Sources suggest the device might even be programmed to yell at your cat.
Would you pay one thousand dollars for a robot that follows you?

LINE 6: Change to 'Would you pay $1,000 for a robot with such limited functionality?'
